summary: Record who holds the store's writer and who keeps a read transaction open past its target, and report it as the writer-hold objective on GET /v1/client/request-latency and in st doctor

schema.detail: In-memory accounting only; no database changes.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged; members may upgrade in any order.

compatibility.detail: GET /v1/client/request-latency gains a writer-hold row in targets with in_progress, holders, long_holds, long_reads, open_reads, windows and read_windows. Existing rows, including transaction.writer_hold and the OTLP gauges, are unchanged.

downtime.detail: A daemon restart to install the build; no extra interruption.

manual.detail: Nothing to configure: the record is always on and bounded to 64 holders, 64 long holds and 64 long reads in memory.

recovery.detail: Swap back to the previous binary freely; nothing is persisted.
